samf-senior-2022-r2-02.prompt: How many of the integers $1, 2, 3, 4, \ldots, 100$ are not multiples of 6?

The speed of the second car is 50 km/h. In how many hours will the cars meet?

samf-senior-2022-r2-11.prompt: Sardines are sold in cylindrical tins. New tins, with the diameters increased by 25%, are designed. By what percentage should the height of the new tins be decreased to keep the volume of the tins the same?

samf-senior-2022-r2-16.prompt: How many four-digit numbers divisible by 12 can be formed using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5, if a digit may be used only once in each number?

If the money is divided fairly between Connor and Sibu, how much did Connor get?
